outcomes.question: Does the one held-out workshop attribution score as anomalous?
Do 67 documented pupils separate from the cohort? (fixed-1500 px)
Signal B, once every pixel means 0.20 mm of canvas
Signal A, fed 224 px tiles with no resize and no crop
Both signals swept 0.15-0.30 mm/px on a fixed population

ruled_out.claim: The held-out set was too small to conclude anything.
ruled_out.test: Raised the held-out class from 1 work to 67 documented pupils of Rembrandt, catalogued under their own names, pre-registered before acquisition.
ruled_out.result: Closed. AUC 0.419 on N=67 -- below chance, not merely unproven.

ruled_out.claim: The features were fine; the images were measured at different scales.
ruled_out.test: Recorded catalogued size and native IIIF resolution for every work, then measured what each pipeline stage actually saw.
ruled_out.result: Confirmed, and worse than expected. Analyzed scale varied 35x, and the CNN never once reached 0.30 mm/px on any of 108 works.

ruled_out.claim: Fix the scale and the handcrafted features will work.
ruled_out.test: Replaced fixed-pixel downloads with fixed-area IIIF tiles -- 30 mm of canvas at 150 px, so one pixel is 0.20 mm on every painting -- and recomputed the same eight features, unchanged.
ruled_out.result: Closed. AUC 0.469. Against the same works on fixed-pixel input, dAUC = +0.042, CI [-0.141, +0.223]: indistinguishable from no change.

ruled_out.claim: The CNN was never shown brushwork, so its score was never a fair test.
ruled_out.test: Requested 44.8 mm tiles at 224 px -- the backbone's native input size at the locked floor -- so the tile enters the network with no resize, no crop, and no interpolation.
ruled_out.result: Closed. AUC 0.523. dAUC = +0.132, CI [-0.092, +0.352]: the largest movement any change produced, and still centred on chance.

ruled_out.claim: 0.20 mm/px was simply the wrong scale to look at.
ruled_out.test: Swept both signals across 0.15 / 0.20 / 0.25 / 0.30 mm/px on a population held fixed across floors, with the multiplicity correction fixed in advance for all eight tests.
ruled_out.result: Closed. All eight points within 0.047 of chance. None clears the corrected bar; none clears even the uncorrected one.
